spec_match.rationale: Mirrors the current add() algorithm exactly: the full valid-relative-path rules (empty, absolute URL, no leading '/', scheme-relative '//', unparseable), the new 20-per-call / 50-per-parent QuotaExceededError checks, the SubAppsAddResponse installedApps/failedApps records, and the per-app DOMException taxonomy (DataError, InvalidStateError, ConstraintError, OperationError) — all re-verified against the WICG spec text fetched 2026-08-16.

interactive.rationale: The textarea batch builder feeds a real window.subApps.add() call; validation, quota, unsupported and resolved/rejected branches each produce distinct live output, and reset restores the deliberately-broken sample.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises spec validation, quota checks and path-by-path response mapping; the page delivers each, including the two response tables that render only from a real resolved response.

edge_cases.rationale: The default sample deliberately trips three distinct validation failures (slash-less, scheme-relative, absolute URL) plus a duplicate for the InvalidStateError story; a 21-path batch explains QuotaExceededError; batch-level and per-app error taxonomies are documented separately.

references.rationale: Links the chromestatus entry, the spec's add() section, the official sample, and the sibling identity-roundtrip concept.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite asserts add()'s TypeError rejection for both a slash-less and a '//' path (add-rejects-invalid-relative-paths), matching this page's validation preview, and records the un-automatable consent flow as an honest manual/blocked assertion.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome via the repo CDP harness (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable in this cloud environment): default sample click asserted the TypeError explanation naming all three invalid paths; a valid batch asserted the honest unsupported branch with the exact would-be payload echoed; a generated 21-path batch asserted the QuotaExceededError explainer; reset asserted; zero console errors/warnings, zero network failures; responsive-check screenshots read for both classes.

telemetry_health.rationale: Distinct asserts per branch: subapps-add-path-validation, subapps-add-quota-validation, subapps-add-unsupported, subapps-add-resolved, subapps-add-batch-rejected — fallbacks never masquerade as success.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout; primary and secondary buttons set background+color pairs; response tables colour only their borders (emerald/rose) keeping text at full contrast; textarea and result output wrap long tokens with overflow-wrap:anywhere.

accessibility.rationale: The textarea has an explicit label describing the format, the result region is an aria-live output announced on the same activation, both response tables carry captions and scoped headers, and the failure taxonomy is a semantic dl.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Measured post-interaction at 360×740 DPR3: scrollWidth=360 with the validation message expanded (dl collapses to one column below 480px); desktop 1280 exercised with the same script; feature-level responsive-check OK on both classes.

openQuestions.title: Exercise a real partially-failing add() batch inside an installed IWA
openQuestions.detail: The resolved-response tables (installedApps/failedApps mapping) are implemented and unit-reasoned from the spec dictionaries but have never rendered from a live SubAppsAddResponse, since add() cannot resolve outside an isolated-app:// context. When a ChromeOS 152 IWA environment is available, install a batch containing one duplicate to confirm the InvalidStateError row renders in the failed table alongside installed rows.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible form validation radio group select policy inputs
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label every input with format expectations and announce validation feedback through the same interaction that triggered it, not silently.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The textarea label states the one-per-line valid-relative-path format; validation, quota and unsupported messages all land in the aria-live output on the add-button activation.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP interaction run 2026-08-16: all four message branches asserted in the output element.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table long identifiers narrow mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap long unbreakable identifiers with overflow-wrap and keep wide content inside its own scroll container.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: overflow-wrap:anywhere on result output and table cells; the illustrative response pre keeps overflow-x:auto; dl collapses to a single column under 480px.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Mobile measurement 2026-08-16: scrollWidth=360 after tripping the longest validation message.

summary: Adaptation of the v150 install-response-map upgraded to the current spec text: validation now covers all five valid-relative-path rules (the v150 page only checked the leading slash) and the new 20/50 QuotaExceededError limits, with batch-level vs per-app error taxonomies split into separate documented sections. Every branch exercised headlessly with zero console errors; mobile and desktop matrix pass.
